working_tree_semantics: Round 5A.1 was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. The clean checkpoint was preserved as the comparison base. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

post_activation_closed_chat_carrier_amen.scope: Provider-neutral Chat reasoning carrier closure; no schema, durable owner, provider-name branch, or Responses item-contract expansion.
post_activation_closed_chat_carrier_amen.unknown_fallback: empty/null is ignored; non-empty with a complete ordinary final text is not replayed; non-empty with tool continuation or as the only output fails before assistant acceptance and tool dispatch
post_activation_closed_chat_carrier_amen.preterminal_accumulator: Chat adapter v5 reuses the 16777216-byte completed-response physical bound and allows 65536 fragments/elements before freeze/append; text uses chunk lists; unknown non-empty fields retain one boolean only; overflow is typed and non-retryable

provider_output_contract.whole_response_atomicity: Only COMPLETED may install one complete assistant message; OUTPUT_INCOMPLETE and PROVIDER_ERROR install no assistant, tool attempt, or physical tool effect.
provider_output_contract.chat_observed_subset_replay: Only known fields actually observed in one completed response are replayed; a standard Chat tool response with no reasoning carrier installs no empty fragment.
provider_output_contract.chat_unknown_field_policy: Empty/null values are no-ops. A non-empty unknown field is discarded only with complete supported final text and no tool continuation; otherwise it is a typed pre-acceptance contract failure.

chat_preterminal_reasoning_bounds.overflow: typed source item/payload limit before terminal; retry count remains one

provider_output_contract.chat_terminal_echo: After the first semantic terminal, an identical finish_reason with an empty assistant delta is idempotent transport metadata. Usage may be installed once or repeated exactly; conflicting reason, semantic delta, final message, or usage still fails closed.
provider_output_contract.responses_public_order: At most one message item is accepted and it must precede every function_call; reasoning may occur anywhere. Non-representable order fails before canonical acceptance.
provider_output_contract.reasoning_replay: A bounded completed-response carrier is process-local, reserves exact Host/epoch capacity before assistant mutation, promotes only after the exact winner is FULL, and is replayed exactly only inside the same Host, scope, target/profile, and continuity epoch.

wire_input_and_settlement.plan_first: One FrozenProviderWireInputPlan materializes root policy, tools, ordered input, exact reasoning replacements, quote, and wire fingerprints before preflight.
wire_input_and_settlement.continuity_cas: The Host-scoped continuity owner atomically validates and installs both the compiler semantic view and the actual wire SYSTEM/tools/input proof before open_once.
wire_input_and_settlement.strict_prefix: For one compatible Host/scope/epoch, SYSTEM and tools are byte-stable and ordered provider wire input is equal or append-only suffix.
wire_input_and_settlement.assistant_settlement: One Host-owned shielded AssistantMessageSettlementAttempt owns the stable assistant candidate and immutable replay-capacity reservation through FULL/NONE/CONFLICT confirmation; caller cancellation detaches and cannot abandon an ACK-unknown winner.
wire_input_and_settlement.auxiliary_incomplete: Auxiliary JSON consumers parse only COMPLETED output and treat incomplete output as a typed non-result.
wire_input_and_settlement.tool_effect_on_incomplete: No attempt is accepted and physical invocation count remains zero.
